"OTOREKE" ACROSS THE INTERNET ARCHIVE BOOK CORPUS — ALL 15 ITEMS
================================================================
Swept 2026-09-06 under p_454's successor work. Open Library search-inside,
`openlibrary.org/search/inside.json`, exact phrase, page 1 (total 15, all on one page).

WHY THIS SWEEP AND NOT AN EARLIER ONE. This project has enumerated "Kanawana" (76 items,
cached beside this file) and run "Camp Kanawana" (8) and "Kamp Kanawana" (13). IT HAD NEVER RUN
THE CAMP'S OTHER NAME. Twelve of the fifteen items below were not in sources.json.

WHAT ELSE WAS TRIED, AND THE NULLS, WHICH ARE FACTS ABOUT THE ENDPOINT AND NOT ABOUT THE WORLD:
  "YMCA camp Saint-Sauveur"   total 0   — a descriptive phrase, not a phrase anyone prints
  "Lake Wilson Quebec"        total 0   — same
  "Kanawanian"                total 0   — the camp's own word for its alumni is in no digitized book
  "Lake Wilson"               total 1916 — too generic to enumerate
  "Saint-Sauveur-des-Monts"   total 657  — same
  "Camp Otoreke"              total 5    — a subset of the 15
The exact-phrase endpoint answers names, not descriptions. Two of the three phrases the
standing research note listed as untried were never going to return anything, and that is worth
recording so nobody tries them a third time.

THE FIFTEEN
-----------
 1. lequbecenpleinai0000laru      Larue & Belec, Le Quebec en plein air (2016). ALREADY HELD.
 2. youthjobsincanad0000cana      Canadian Youth Commission, "Youth & Jobs in Canada"
                                  (Toronto: Ryerson Press, 1945). NEW — see f_5196.
 3. rpertoirelusaged0000unse      "Repertoire a l'usage des astrologues des longitudes et
                                  latitudes des villes, villages et lieux du Quebec" (1985).
                                  "Otoreke (Argenteuil)" in a place-name list. NEW.
 4. whour0000neya                 Arthur Ney, "W Hour" (Azrieli Foundation, 2014).
                                  Photo caption, 1947. NEW — see f_5198.
 5. annualreport1st40000unit_i6g0 United Church of Canada, Board of Evangelism and Social
                                  Service, Annual Report 1967, vol. 42. NEW — see f_5199.
 6. spanishstageinti0000hugo_m9h5 FALSE FRIEND. "carep otoreke corots Yohe totolons" — OCR noise
                                  in a book on the Spanish stage. Not a hit in any real sense.
 7. montrealmuseumof0000mcma      Evelyn de R. McMann, "Montreal Museum of Fine Arts, formerly
                                  Art Association of Montreal: Spring Exhibitions 1880-1970"
                                  (University of Toronto Press, 1988). NEW — see f_5197.
 8. isbn_0888500963               A road atlas gazetteer: "Otoreke, UP (Que.) 18 F4". NEW.
 9-12. mcgrawhilldirect0000unse and three sibling scans — the McGraw-Hill postal directory
                                  series this project already used for KANAWANA's post office.
                                  One of them carries "Otoreke, PQ (S), see ... St-Adolphe-de-
                                  Howard", the same closed-and-renamed cross-reference form.
                                  One item HELD; the three siblings are not.
13-15. canadianalmanacd0000unse and two sibling scans — Canadian Almanac, "Otoreke ...
                                  Argenteuil ... Ste. Agathe". Two are already cited in the KB.

THE SNIPPETS, VERBATIM
----------------------
youthjobsincanad0000cana:
  "encourage public works (when needed) to control capital investments, etc. (Camp Otoreke,
   Montreal, Y.M.C.A.)"
  "...that there should be equal pay for equal work as between the sexes. (Camp Otoreke,
   Y.M.C.A., Montreal.)"

montrealmuseumof0000mcma, walked backwards over six overlapping queries to reach the artist's
name, which the hit itself does not contain:
  "ROBERTSON, DORIS  addr: Montreal: 1509 Bishop St, 1933; 3555 University St, 1935-6; 1461
   Mountain St, 1938-46 | 1933 484 Moving in wd cut $3.50 | 485 Whither lino cut $4 |
   486 Supplication wd cut $4 | 1935 436 Native carrying fruit wd cut $6 |
   1936 565 CAMP OTOREKE, LAURENTIANS  LINO BLOCK  $7 | 566 Heavyweight wd cut $6 |
   1938 177 Indian and totem lino cut $7 | 1946 209 Laurentian window $100 |
   ROBERTSON, HAZEL M. addr: Montreal..."
  The next artist alphabetically is what fixed the surname: the entries sort between ROBERTSON,
  DORIS and ROBERTSON, HAZEL M.

whour0000neya:
  "1947. 2  Summer vacation with friends at ymca Camp Otoreke in the Laurentians. Arthur is in
   front, centre."

annualreport1st40000unit_i6g0:
  "meeting was held in conjunction with the 'Summer Event' of Kairos at Camp Otoreke in the
   Laurentians, August 29th-September 2nd ... theology relevant to technology and automation.
   At Otoreke we held a joint consultation with the Kairos Executive"

rpertoirelusaged0000unse:
  "(Gaspe) Oskelaneo (Abitibi) Otis (Chicoutimi) OTOREKE (ARGENTEUIL) Otter (Saguenay)
   Otterburn (Temiscouata)"

isbn_0888500963:
  "Oswald, UP (Man.) 29 H3  Othello, UP (BC) 35 B4  OTOREKE, UP (QUE.) 18 F4  Otosquen, UP
   (Sask.) 32 H3"

METHOD NOTE. `identifier` in each hit is a LIST, not a string — extract `[0]`. Paging is
`&page=N`; `&from=` and `&offset=` are accepted and silently ignored. None of these books was
read: every passage above is a search highlight, and the four longer reconstructions were built
by walking overlapping phrase queries outward from the first hit.
